decision: The full two-file patch guards a missing panel during enabled-motion immediate open/close and adds a regression without an animation module. The owned exit method already has the equivalent !animationsEnabled || !this.panel branch, followed by its locally owned CSS/state completion. Two added enabled/disabled missing-view lifecycle cases verify closed/detached state, one void completion and no timers/listeners; removing the guard fails the intended enabled case. All32 prior/new menu-select lifecycle cases and15 corruptions pass. Complete exact minimum exit and detach method bodies also detach/mark once for each missing-panel enabled/disabled receiver. The current public derived open has separately recorded stable-callback lifetime guards, but this diagnostic does not instantiate the public Angular directive. One actual enabled-motion legacy native test is added and remains unexecuted.
